name: Will Hutchins
summary: Will Hutchins helped carry the terrified, collapsed Curtis Whateley to the roadside after his glimpse of the horror on Sentinel Hill.
description: Will Hutchins, together with Fred Farr, carried the collapsed Curtis Whateley to the roadside and laid him on the damp grass after his terrifying glimpse of the creature.

sources.quote: Fred Farr and Will Hutchins carried him to the roadside and laid him on the damp grass.

facts: Helped carry the collapsed Curtis Whateley to the roadside.
